column1: 02.intro-flow|一张芯片布局，通常先由工具自动生成，再由工程师调整。拿到这些坐标，能直接比较好坏吗？先别急着评分。如果两块占了同一片地方，或者有一块越出芯片边界，这份结果根本不能用。这一课先把这道检查关做好。|A floorplan usually starts with automatic placement, followed by manual adjustments. Can we compare its quality straight away? First we need to check whether it can be used at all. Overlapping blocks or a block outside the chip boundary invalidate the result. This lab builds that first line of checks.

02.intro-overflow|看这份结果：五块都在，看着也整齐。不过，E从横坐标九开始，宽是二，右边就到了十一。外框只到十，它已经越界了。检查器要把这种错误稳定地找出来。|All five blocks are present, and the arrangement looks tidy. But E starts at x equals nine and is two units wide. Its right edge reaches eleven, beyond the boundary at ten. A validator must catch this reliably.

02.intro-goal|学完这课，你要能写出一个检查器：给它模块清单、外框和一组坐标，它就能指出全部错误。我们还会用一个反例说明，面积够，并不代表真的放得下。后面的评分和搜索，都要先过这一关。|By the end, you will build a validator that takes a block catalog, an outline, and a set of coordinates, then reports every violation. A counterexample will also show why enough total area does not guarantee a feasible placement. Later scoring and search depend on these checks.

02.box|先看这五块。每个模块都要放进去，尺寸按清单来；既不能越过外框，也不能压到别的模块。接下来，我们把这些要求变成能计算的条件。|Start with these five blocks. Every required block must be present with its specified dimensions. None may extend outside the outline or overlap another block. We will turn these requirements into conditions that a program can evaluate.

02.contract|先约定清楚：A到E各放一块，尺寸固定，这一课不允许旋转。坐标从左下角算起，横向向右，纵向向上。程序检查的是这些输入数据，不能只数图上有几个矩形。|Here are our assumptions. Place A through E exactly once, keep their specified dimensions, and allow no rotation. The origin is at the lower left, with x increasing rightward and y upward. Validate the input records, rather than simply counting rectangles on screen.

02.numbers|有些输入连有效的矩形都算不上。比如宽高是零、负数，或坐标是无穷大。先把这些情况筛掉，再核对模块尺寸。否则后面的几何计算就失去了意义。|Some inputs do not describe valid rectangles at all: zero or negative dimensions, for example, or infinite coordinates. Reject these first, then compare each block with its specified dimensions. Otherwise the geometry calculations have no useful meaning.
02.right|现在把E向右移。它从九开始，宽是二，右边缘就到了十一。|Now move E to the right. It starts at nine and is two units wide, so its right edge reaches eleven.
02.outside|外框只到十。哪怕E的大部分还在里面，只要右边越出去，整个布局就不能通过。|The outline ends at ten. Most of E is still inside, but its right edge is outside. That is enough to reject the placement.

02.bounds|所以，只看左下角不够。右边缘要加上宽度，上边缘要加上高度。左、下、右、上四条边都在框里，才算完整放下。|Checking the lower-left corner is not enough. Add the width to get the right edge, and the height to get the top edge. All four sides must lie within the outline.
02.touch|让E回到横坐标七，刚好贴住C。两块共用一条边，但没有占用同一片内部空间，所以允许。|Bring E back to x equals seven, where it touches C. They share a boundary, but no interior area. This is allowed.
02.predict|如果E再向左移一格呢？先想一下：这次只是贴边，还是会占到C的内部？|What if E moves one more unit to the left? Will it still only touch C, or will their interiors overlap?
02.overlap|移完再看，两块之间出现了一条有宽度的共同区域。这次确实重叠了。下面把这片面积算出来。|After the move, a strip of positive width is shared by both blocks. This really is an overlap. Let us calculate its area.

02.project-x|先看横向。C从五到七，E从六到八，共同的一段是六到七，宽一。不过，只看横向还不能下结论：它们也可能在不同高度。|First look along x. C spans five to seven, and E spans six to eight. Their shared interval is six to seven, one unit wide. This alone does not prove overlap: the blocks could still be at different heights.

02.project-y|再看纵向，两块都从零到二，共同高度是二。横向宽一，纵向高二，相乘就是重叠面积二。两个方向都有正长度，才真正占了同一片地方。|Along y, both blocks span zero to two, so the shared height is two. Width one times height two gives an overlap area of two. Both shared lengths must be positive for the interiors to overlap.

02.formula|把刚才的做法写成公式。共同区间的右端，取两个右边缘里较小的；左端取两个左边缘里较大的。两端相减，负数按零算。高度也一样，再把宽和高相乘。|Now write the calculation generally. The intersection ends at the smaller right edge and starts at the larger left edge. Subtract the two, and clamp negative results to zero. Do the same for height, then multiply the shared width and height.

02.contacts|共边时，至少有一个方向的共同长度为零。共角也一样，没有正面积。所以判断重叠要严格大于零，不能把刚好相等也算进去。|When blocks share an edge, at least one intersection length is zero. Corner contact also has zero area. Test for strictly positive overlap, rather than treating equality as a collision.

02.contained|再看一块完全包在另一块里面的情况。它们当然重叠，但不需要另外写一套特殊规则。刚才的区间公式，照样能算出交集面积。|Now put one block entirely inside another. They clearly overlap, but we do not need a special-case algorithm. The same interval calculation gives the intersection area.

02.cross|只查角点会漏掉这种情况。两条长块在中间交叉，角点却都没进到对方里面。共同宽二、高二，面积四。用区间求交，就不会漏报。|A corner-only test misses this crossing. None of either rectangle's corners lies inside the other, yet their centers overlap. The intersection is two by two, with area four. Interval intersection catches it.

02.complete|再查模块名称。表里有五个矩形，不等于A到E都放对了。重复一个、漏掉一个，总数仍然可能是五。|Check identities as well. Five rectangles do not necessarily mean that A through E are all present correctly. One duplicate and one missing block can leave the count unchanged.

02.multiple|一张图里可能不止一个错误。这里D同时压到A和B，E还越过了右边界。检查器要把这些问题一起报出来，不能找到第一个就停。|A layout can contain several errors at once. Here D overlaps both A and B, while E crosses the right boundary. Report all of them, rather than stopping after the first violation.

02.new-conflict|把D往右挪，原来和A、B的冲突没了，可它又压到了C。修好旧问题，不等于整张图已经修好。每次移动之后，都要重新检查。|Move D right, and its old overlaps with A and B disappear. But now it overlaps C. Fixing an old problem does not prove that the whole layout is valid. Check again after every edit.

02.recheck|完整检查分三步：先查数据和名称，再查尺寸与边界，最后查全部模块对。五块一共有十对。报告里要写明哪块出了什么问题，方便下一次修复。|Use three stages: validate values and identities, check dimensions and boundaries, then test every pair of blocks. Five blocks make ten pairs. Each reported violation should identify the blocks and the failed condition.

02.necessary|最后看这个例子。四乘四的框里，放三乘二和二乘三两块，不许旋转。总面积十二，比框的十六小。空间总量够了，形状也一定能放下吗？|Finally, try a three-by-two block and a two-by-three block in a four-by-four outline, without rotation. Their total area is twelve, below the available sixteen. Does enough total area guarantee that these shapes fit?

02.separation|要不重叠，两块至少得在横向或纵向分开。左右放，需要宽三加二，等于五；上下放，需要高二加三，也等于五。框的宽和高都只有四，所以两种办法都不行。这才证明了放不下。|To avoid overlap, the blocks must be separated horizontally or vertically. Side by side, they need width three plus two: five. Stacked, they need height two plus three: also five. Both outline dimensions are only four. Neither separation is possible, which proves infeasibility.

02.transfer|写代码时，别把标准坐标抄进去。模块数量、尺寸和外框都从参数读。换一份没见过的数据，检查器也应该给出正确结果。|Do not hard-code the demonstration coordinates. Read the block count, dimensions, and outline from the arguments. Your validator must work on data it has never seen before.
02.turn|接下来进入实验。先找错，再修复，最后构造一个能让错误检查方法漏报的反例。|Now try the lab: diagnose errors, repair a placement, then build a counterexample that defeats an incorrect checker.

03.intro-select|上一课能判断布局能不能用。但合法摆法往往不止一种，该挑哪个？这就需要评价指标。指标如果选错，工具就可能把布局越改越差。先看一个怎么挪都不变的数。|The previous lab checked whether a layout is valid. But there are usually several valid layouts. Which one should we choose? We need a metric. A poorly chosen metric can drive the tool in the wrong direction. Start with one that never changes when blocks move.

03.intro-trap||With fixed blocks and a fixed outline, outline utilization is twenty-three divided by eighty. Packing the blocks more tightly does not change it. A constant metric cannot measure compaction. Before comparing results, distinguish fixed quantities from quantities that respond to placement.

03.intro-goal|这一课要写一份完整的评价报告：接上检查器，筛掉非法布局，再算包围盒和两种密度。我们还会比较面积相同、宽高不同的候选，看看固定外框会怎样改变选择。|This lab builds a complete evaluation report. Use the validator first, then compute the bounding box and two density measures. We will also compare candidates with equal area but different dimensions, and see how a fixed outline changes the choice.
03.invariant||The five blocks have total area twenty-three. Moving them changes their positions, but never this total.
03.outline||The fixed outline has area eighty. Its utilization is therefore twenty-three divided by eighty.

03.constant||With fixed block dimensions and outline, moving blocks does not change twenty-three over eighty. It describes occupied outline area, but not the compaction we just performed. Ask whether a proposed objective responds to the operation being evaluated.
03.bbox||Now focus on the bounding box: the smallest axis-aligned rectangle enclosing all the blocks.
03.twentyseven||This arrangement has a nine-by-three bounding box, with four units of empty area inside it.

03.extents||Shift the entire arrangement right by one and up by two. Its dimensions remain nine by three. The left edge is now one and the right edge ten, so width is ten minus one. Height is five minus two.

03.translation-bug||Multiplying the largest right and top coordinates gives ten times five: fifty. That incorrectly includes the gap from the origin. Translation should preserve the compaction score, making it a useful test for bounding-box code.
03.predict||If a new arrangement reduces the bounding box, will utilization of the fixed outline increase as well?
03.twentyfour||After rearrangement, the box is six by four, with area twenty-four. Only one unit remains empty inside it.
03.denominator||Outline utilization stays constant while packing density increases. These ratios answer different questions because their denominators differ.

03.accounting||Empty area in the fixed outline is eighty minus twenty-three: fifty-seven. Inside the bounding box, it falls from twenty-seven minus twenty-three to twenty-four minus twenty-three. Always specify which region defines empty area.

03.illegal||This candidate also has box area twenty-four, but C and E overlap. It cannot compete in the ranking of valid layouts. Keep the geometric box for diagnosis, but do not award it a valid packing-density score.

03.missing||Omitting E can make the box smaller. But our task is to place every required block, not as few blocks as possible. An invalid result must have no optimization score, even if its geometric box looks attractive.

03.order||Fix the evaluation order. Validate first, compute the true bounding box, then calculate each density with its stated denominator. Compare candidates under the same conditions and objective. This prevents missing or overlapping blocks from being rewarded.

03.width-tradeoff||Place E above C. Width drops from nine to seven, but height rises from three to four. Area increases from twenty-seven to twenty-eight. Whether that is an improvement depends on whether we optimize width, area, or feasibility in a particular outline.

03.fit-filter||Now compare three-block arrangements with boxes six by two and three by four. Both have area twelve. In a four-by-four outline, the first is too wide and the second fits. Filter by width and height before ranking by area.

03.budget-denominators||Empty area equal to fifteen percent of block area differs from empty area equal to fifteen percent of the total region. The first budget multiplies block area by one point one five. The second divides it by zero point eight five.

03.budget-values||For total block area twenty-three, the budgets are twenty-six point four five and about twenty-seven point zero six. These are area budgets under different definitions. Neither proves that particular shapes can be packed into an outline.

03.report||Your Python function should return more than one area. Include validity, diagnostics, bounding-box extents, both denominators, and the corresponding scores. Preserve diagnostics for invalid inputs, while leaving their optimization scores unset.
03.limits||Real chips also need interconnect and routing space. This lab compares only the geometric objectives stated explicitly.

03.transfer||The experiments change outlines and constraints. Construct counterexamples to incorrect formulas, filter infeasible candidates, and explain a result that is narrower but has greater area. State the conditions and denominator before drawing a conclusion.

04.intro-context|直接搜索所有模块坐标，组合太多。另一种办法是先用短编码描述结构，再把编码还原成坐标。切片表达式就是一种这样的表示。这一课从九个符号出发，一步步算回整张布局。|Searching all coordinate combinations is too expensive. Instead, we can encode a layout structure and decode it into coordinates. A slicing expression is one such representation. In this lab, nine symbols will lead us step by step to a complete placement.

04.intro-task|我们要完成四件事：读表达式、建树、算区域尺寸、再传坐标。仍然用原来的五块模块，尺寸固定，不许旋转。关键不在背坐标，而在解释每一个坐标是怎么算出来的。|We will parse an expression, build its tree, calculate region sizes, and propagate coordinates. The five blocks retain fixed dimensions, with no rotation. The goal is not to memorize positions, but to explain how each position follows from the structure.

04.intro-preview|先看这条表达式：A、D、H，后面依次接B、V、C、V、E、V。解码后，就是前两课的九乘三布局。先从最前面的两个模块和一个运算符看起。|Our running expression begins with A, D, H, then adds B, V, C, V, E, V. It decodes to the nine-by-three layout from the earlier labs. Start with the first two blocks and their combining operator.
04.notation||Letters represent blocks. H and V describe how two regions are combined.
04.h-convention||H denotes a horizontal cut. The first region goes below, and the second goes above.

04.v-convention||V denotes a vertical cut: first region left, second region right. Add widths and take the larger height. The first region is popped second from the stack. Keeping operand order explicit prevents mirrored placements.
04.max-add||Pop D first, then A. H places D above A. The combined region is three by three.
04.stack-start||Push A, then D. D is now at the top of the stack.

04.stack-combine||At H, pop two regions. D is the second operand, and A is the first. Combine them with maximum width and summed height, then push the new three-by-three region. Two stack entries become one.
04.full-decode||Use V to attach B, C, and E in turn. The final bounding box is nine by three.

04.decode-steps||Follow the nine tokens. Push A and D, combine them with H, then push and attach B, C, and E using V. Every operator replaces two regions with one. The final stack contains one nine-by-three region; its maximum depth was two.

04.coords-result||The decoded origins are A at zero, zero; D at zero, two; B at three, zero; C at five, zero; and E at seven, zero. These coordinates come from the combining rules, rather than being stored in the expression.
04.sizes-up||View the same computation as a tree. Leaves supply block dimensions. Each internal H or V combines its two children's sizes. Work upward to obtain the root dimensions, nine by three.

04.coords-down||Now propagate origins downward from the root at zero, zero. At V, offset the right child by the left child's width. At H, offset the upper child by the lower child's height. A leaf's coordinate accumulates these offsets along its path.

04.order-matters||Size calculation precedes coordinate propagation. Without subtree dimensions, we cannot determine the sibling offset. An implementation may combine traversal work, but it must preserve this dependency.
04.three-checks||One final stack entry is only a structural condition. It does not replace identity checks or outline checks.

04.prefix-condition|读到运算符时，栈里至少要有两个区域。比如A后面立刻接H，就不够弹。只查总数也不行：画面这条表达式有五个字母、四个运算符，可第二个符号就是H，仍然当场失败。必须边读边检查。|Every operator needs two regions already on the stack. A followed immediately by H fails. Counting tokens is insufficient: the expression shown has five letters and four operators, but H appears second and still underflows. Validate every prefix as you read.

04.final-one||After the final token, exactly one region must remain, and every required block must appear exactly once. These structural and identity checks come before validating the resulting geometry and outline containment.
04.overflow||Replace the first H with V. All blocks form one horizontal row, making the total width twelve.

04.swap-operands||Reverse A and D before H. D now goes below A. Their combined region remains three by three, so the total box is still nine by three, but their coordinates change. Equal decoded sizes do not imply equal placements.

04.first-cut||Can every layout be sliced? In the standard placement, a vertical cut at x equals three separates A and D from B, C, and E without crossing any block interior. That provides a first cut, after which each side can be split recursively.

04.pinwheel||Consider this five-block pinwheel filling a five-by-five square. A vertical line at two point five crosses three block interiors. Horizontal lines are blocked as well. Test possible cut positions at block boundaries to see why no first cut exists.

04.pinwheel-proof|四条内部候选切线都被模块挡住，所以风车布局没有第一刀，写不成切片树。前面面积二十四的布局也没有第一刀。但要证明所有切片编码都达不到二十四，还得查完整搜索空间：本实例穷举两万六千八百八十份，最小是二十五。单张布局的反例，不能代替这个穷举结论。|All four internal candidate cuts are blocked. This pinwheel has no first cut, so no slicing tree represents it. The earlier area-twenty-four witness is also nonslicing. A stronger claim needs separate evidence: exhaustive enumeration of twenty-six thousand eight hundred eighty slicing encodings gives minimum area twenty-five for this instance. One nonslicing example alone does not prove that minimum.

04.edit-neighborhood||Treat expressions as a search space. Change an operator or swap operands, then decode, validate, and score the result again. Representation plus neighborhood will form the basis of search in Lab seven. Here, focus on getting decoding right.
04.transfer||In the lab, read tokens one at a time, inspect the stack and tree, and construct a different valid placement.

05.intro-why|切片树写不出所有布局。上一课那张六乘四的摆法，就找不到第一刀。要突破这个限制，可以换用B星树：树决定相对摆放关系，轮廓线决定落点高度。这一课把这两个步骤接起来。|Slicing trees cannot describe every placement. The earlier six-by-four witness has no first cut. A B-star tree removes this slicing restriction: the tree supplies placement relations, and a contour determines landing heights. This lab connects those two steps.

05.intro-task||Decode the complete tree in preorder. A left child starts at its parent's right edge; a right child shares its parent's x coordinate. Place each block above the highest contour across its full width. You should be able to justify every landing height and explain which blocks a tree edit affects.

05.intro-preview||In the standard tree, A is the root. B, C, and E form a left-child chain, and D is A's right child. Decoding it gives the familiar nine-by-three layout, this time through a tree and contour.
05.convention||The tree gives horizontal placement relations. The contour determines the final vertical position of each block.
05.preorder||Place root A at the origin, then process its entire left subtree.

05.order-matters|为什么要先处理整个左子树？根放好以后，如果先摆D，D看到的轮廓就变了，后面各块的落点也会跟着变。只要仍然正确查询和更新轮廓，不一定会重叠，但已经不是本课规定的解码结果。遍历顺序是算法约定的一部分。|Why process the entire left subtree first? Placing D earlier changes the contour it sees, which can change later landing positions. Correct full-width contour queries still prevent overlap, but the result is no longer the decoder specified here. Traversal order is part of that algorithm's contract.
05.golden-walk||Each left child starts at its parent's right edge. Place B, C, and E in order, then process D.
05.d-landing||In the standard tree, the highest contour under D is A's top edge. D therefore lands at height two.

05.contour-update||Updating the contour takes three steps: split any partially covered old segments, replace the covered interval with the new top height, then merge adjacent equal-height segments. D raises zero through three to height three, which merges with the neighboring segment ending at five.
05.swap-predict||If A and C exchange names in the tree, will D still land at height two?
05.lift-result||After the exchange, D spans the taller B. Its landing height rises to three.

05.lift-anatomy||D queries the whole interval from zero to three. Under it are contour portions at heights two and three. Taking their maximum places D at three. A right child does not simply sit on its parent: that was only a coincidence in the standard tree.

05.segments||Query the entire half-open width interval, not just one point or the parent block. A wide block may span several contour segments. Include only positive-length intersections; touching a segment endpoint does not make that segment support the block.

05.residual-detail||Watch the uncovered remainder. D occupies x from three to six at height one. C covers only three to five, so the height-one segment from five to six must remain. B later queries five to seven and lands at one. Deleting the remainder would incorrectly drop B to zero, overlapping D.

05.neighborhoods||Swapping block names changes dimensions at fixed tree positions. Moving a node changes tree structure and may move a whole subtree. Both edits affect the contour seen by later blocks, so decoding must account for their downstream consequences.

05.pre-checks||Check tree identities before decoding: no unknown, duplicate, or missing block names. The contour construction prevents overlap for valid trees, but does not enforce the outline. In this instance, three hundred sixty of the enumerated trees overflow it.

05.enum-facts||There are forty-two binary-tree shapes for five nodes and one hundred twenty labelings, giving five thousand forty labeled trees. Four thousand six hundred eighty fit the ten-by-eight outline. The minimum bounding area is twenty-four, achieved by eight trees. Nonoverlap alone does not imply compactness.

05.enum-bound||These counts and the minimum apply only to this five-block instance, fixed dimensions, no rotation, and the stated outline. Changing the catalog changes the result. Enumeration here is an explicit small-instance experiment, not a background search.
05.score-compare||The box area rises from twenty-seven to thirty-six. Validity alone does not tell us whether a tree edit improves the objective.
05.transfer||Edit trees in the lab, then justify landing heights using the full contour. Do not rely on memorized child rules alone.

06.intro-why||A sequence pair uses two permutations to encode relative positions. Comparing the two orders assigns a horizontal or vertical constraint to every pair of blocks. Longest-path calculations then turn those constraints into coordinates. This lab develops the full decoding procedure.

06.intro-task||Classify every block pair, build both constraint graphs, and compute minimum feasible coordinates in topological order. Explain why the construction prevents overlap, why the graphs are acyclic, and which constraints actually determine a coordinate. Also construct an encoding that overflows the outline.

06.intro-preview||The standard pair is A B C E D, followed by D A B C E. D decodes to zero, three, and the box is nine by four. This is a particular encoding, not the same arrangement as the previous lab's standard tree.
06.notation||A sequence pair uses two ordered lists of block names to describe relative positions.
06.same-order||A precedes B in both permutations. Under our convention, A must lie to the left of B.
06.reverse-order||A precedes D in the first permutation but follows D in the second. Under our convention, A lies below D.

06.all-pairs||Five blocks give ten pairs. Compare both permutations for every pair, assigning exactly one direction each time. Looking only at adjacent names misses constraints between more distant elements.

06.longest-path|D必须在A、B、C、E的上方。它的底边，要同时不低于这四块的顶边，所以取四个值的最大值。这里B最高，顶边是三，D就落在三。推广到整张图，就是沿约束图计算最长路径。|D must lie above A, B, C, and E. Its bottom edge must clear all four top edges, so take their maximum. B is tallest here, with top edge three, placing D at three. Across the full graph, this recurrence is a longest-path calculation.
06.predict-height||B's top edge is one unit above A's. Predict D's final height before continuing.

06.std-result||The decoded D is at zero, three, giving a nine-by-four box with area thirty-six. It fits the outline. This result and the previous tree's area twenty-seven describe two chosen encodings; they do not rank the representations themselves.

06.critical-chain||B is the active predecessor setting D's height. Increase B's height, and D moves upward. Remove E, and D's height stays unchanged. Critical predecessor chains explain how dimension changes propagate through a decoder.

06.acyclic|为什么不会有环？不管横向还是纵向，每条约束边都从第一行里较早的模块，指向较晚的模块。沿着边走，位置只会往后，不可能绕回起点。因此第一行本身就是拓扑序，坐标可以按这个顺序计算。|Why are the graphs acyclic? Every horizontal or vertical edge points from an earlier to a later position in the first permutation. Following edges always moves forward, so returning to the start is impossible. The first permutation is therefore a topological order for computing coordinates.

06.row-overflow||Make both permutations identical. Every pair becomes a horizontal constraint, producing a row twelve units wide. The blocks do not overlap, but E extends beyond the ten-unit outline. Nonoverlapping decoding and outline feasibility are separate properties.

06.fit-check||Sequence-pair decoding prevents internal overlaps by construction, but does not enforce outline containment. Decode first, then apply the validator from Lab two. The same distinction matters when checking tree-based representations.

06.multi-encoding||The fourteen thousand four hundred sequence pairs decode to twelve thousand nine hundred sixty-six distinct layouts. Some layouts have several encodings, with a maximum multiplicity of three in this instance. Different pair orders can impose redundant constraints and produce identical coordinates.

06.compare-reps|标准编码算出的二十七、二十七、三十六，不能拿来给表示法排名。完整枚举才得到：这组固定五块里，B星树和序列对都能到二十四，切片编码最小是二十五。还要分清两种证据：一张布局没有第一刀，只证明它不是切片布局；完整枚举，才证明这里没有别的切片编码能做到二十四。|The standard encodings' areas of twenty-seven, twenty-seven, and thirty-six do not rank representation power. Exhaustive enumeration shows that B-star trees and sequence pairs reach twenty-four here, while slicing encodings reach only twenty-five. Keep the evidence distinct: no first cut proves that a particular layout is nonslicing; exhaustive enumeration establishes the best slicing result for this instance.

06.transfer-preview||A neighborhood can swap two names in one permutation or in both. After every edit, decode, validate, and score again. The next lab uses these edits in simulated annealing. First make the decoder reliable.
06.transfer||Change both permutations in the lab, then implement the full constraint construction and longest-path updates in Python.

07.intro-why|我们已经能把编码还原成布局。可只有五块，就有一万四千四百个序列对；模块再多，逐个试完就不现实了。模拟退火每次只试一个邻居，再决定接受还是拒绝。这一课重点看它怎样作决定，以及怎样可靠地比较结果。|We can now decode an encoding into a layout. Yet five blocks already have fourteen thousand four hundred sequence pairs, and larger problems cannot be enumerated practically. Simulated annealing tries one neighbor at a time, then accepts or rejects it. We will examine those decisions and compare runs fairly.

07.intro-task|这课有三项任务：读懂真实搜索日志，找出拒绝候选时的状态错误，再用相同预算、多组种子比较参数。重点不是看动画有没有变好，而是能拿日志解释每一步。|There are three tasks: audit a real search trace, diagnose state corruption after rejection, and compare parameter settings using equal budgets and multiple seeds. The evidence comes from the log, rather than how promising the animation looks.

07.intro-preview||With seed seven, initial temperature twelve, and one hundred twenty steps, this run finds best valid area twenty-five. That is one run's result. Reproducibility and performance across different seeds are separate questions.
07.components||The representation decodes layouts. Simulated annealing searches among different encodings using an objective, a neighborhood, a temperature schedule, and an acceptance rule.

07.neighbor-swap||Generate a neighbor by swapping two names in one permutation, such as B and E. Decode the candidate afresh and compute its energy. Search edits the encoding; it does not nudge coordinates in an old decoded layout.

07.delta|先算候选能量，再减去当前能量，得到能量差。这里能量是包围盒面积，加上一百倍的超宽和超高。能量下降就接受；能量上升，也不一定拒绝。这个后退的机会，就是退火和贪心的区别。|Subtract current energy from candidate energy. Here energy is box area plus one hundred times total width and height overflow. Accept a decrease directly. An increase may still be accepted; that chance to move uphill distinguishes annealing from greedy search.

07.probability|变差时，接受概率是自然指数函数，指数为负的能量差除以温度。算出概率后，再抽一个零到一之间的随机数。随机数比概率小，才接受。温度越高，同样的变差越容易被接受。|For an uphill move, acceptance probability is the exponential of negative energy increase divided by temperature. Draw a uniform random number between zero and one, and accept only if it is below that probability. Higher temperature makes the same uphill move easier to accept.
07.temp-predict||For the same uphill candidate, does a higher temperature make acceptance more or less likely?

07.real-accept|看第六步的真实日志。候选能量高了十，本步温度已经降到约十点三，接受概率约零点三七九。抽到的随机数是零点一四四，比概率小，所以接受。当前解换成候选，但历史最好合法解要单独保存，不能跟着覆盖。|At step six, energy increases by ten. The temperature has cooled to about ten point three, giving acceptance probability about zero point three seven nine. The random draw is zero point one four four, below that threshold: accept. Update the current state, but keep the best valid state separately.

07.real-reject|再看第二步。候选能量高了九十六，接受概率约零点零零零三。抽到的随机数是零点二四零，比概率大，所以拒绝。拒绝以后，当前编码、布局和能量都得保持原样。候选不能偷偷改掉当前解。|At step two, energy increases by ninety-six. Acceptance probability is only about zero point zero zero zero three, below the random draw of zero point two four zero. Reject it. Current encoding, layout, and energy must remain unchanged; a rejected candidate must not mutate the current state.

07.log-fields||Record temperature, candidate energy, energy difference, random draw, acceptance decision, resulting current energy, and best valid area. With a fixed seed and these fields, another implementation can replay and verify every decision.

07.best-monotonic|历史最好合法面积，只会持平或下降。当前解却可以接受变差。这次种子为三的运行，最后当前能量是二十七，历史最好面积是二十五。报告时要分开写：最后停在哪里，和曾经找到过多好的结果。|The best valid area can only stay constant or improve. Current energy can rise after an uphill acceptance. For seed three, this run ends with current energy twenty-seven, but best area twenty-five. Report the best result and the final state as different quantities.

07.budget-design||Specify initial temperature, cooling rate, step budget, and stopping condition. Here temperature is multiplied by zero point nine seven after each step. Stop when the stated budget is exhausted. These are experiment parameters, not universal constants.

07.equal-budget|公平比较，要用相同预算和多组种子。这里选三、七、十一，每次都跑一百二十步。初始温度十二时，三次最好面积都是二十五；初始温度二时，分别是二十八、二十五、二十七。只能说，在这组数据和参数下，前者更稳。|Use seeds three, seven, and eleven, with one hundred twenty steps each. At initial temperature twelve, all three best areas are twenty-five. At initial temperature two, they are twenty-eight, twenty-five, and twenty-seven. The warmer setting is more consistent in this experiment; that is not a universal ranking.

07.penalty||Our objective includes only box area and outline overflow, not wirelength, timing, or congestion. With penalty weight one hundred, an overflowing candidate has energy two hundred thirty-six and loses to a valid candidate at forty. At weight one, it scores thirty-eight and wins. The weight expresses a modeling choice.

07.reachability|低温可能让搜索不愿接受后退，但还有另一种问题：邻域根本到不了某些状态。这时怎么调温都没用。本课允许交换序列对中的任意两个元素。分析搜索失败时，要先区分走得慢，还是从规则上就走不到。|Low temperature can make uphill moves unlikely. A different problem occurs when the neighborhood cannot reach some states at all; changing temperature cannot repair that. Our neighborhood permits arbitrary transpositions within a sequence. Distinguish slow exploration from structural unreachability.

07.reproducibility|固定种子，是为了让别人能逐步重放，不是保证最优。种子七这次找到二十五；换成种子三、初始温度二，就只有二十八。一次结果漂亮，证明不了算法总是更好，更证明不了全局最优。评价表现，还得做等预算、多种子的比较。|A fixed seed makes a trace reproducible, not optimal. Seed seven may find twenty-five, while seed three at initial temperature two finds twenty-eight. One attractive run proves neither algorithm superiority nor global optimality. Use equal budgets and multiple seeds for performance evidence.
07.transfer||Audit the trace, repair the faulty state machine, and compare settings under equal budgets. Submit the values and explain them using the recorded decisions.
08.intro-why||Many chip blocks have fixed area but adjustable aspect ratio. Changing one shape can force neighbors to move, while placement constraints also restrict which shapes work.
08.intro-course||This final lab brings together validation, scoring, decoding, and search from the earlier lessons.
08.intro-task||We will enumerate shape candidates, determine which combinations fit a fixed outline, and establish exactly where our conclusions apply.
08.intro-preview||Our running example is block A, with area six. If we make it narrower, which block will it hit? How can we repack the layout, and how can we prove that a result cannot be improved?
08.scope||Only A may change shape initially. The other four blocks keep fixed dimensions. All blocks must fit a ten-by-eight outline, and we minimize valid bounding-box area.
08.grid||This example uses positive integer dimensions and integer coordinates. The optimality proof later depends on both assumptions.
08.couple-height||A's area stays six. Once its width is chosen, height must be six divided by width. These two dimensions cannot be chosen independently.
08.couple-bound||Substitute that height into the aspect-ratio bounds to obtain an interval of allowed widths. Then retain the integer factor pairs that preserve area.
08.couple-filter||One by six and six by one violate the aspect-ratio bounds. Only two by three and three by two remain as integer candidates.
08.couple-model||The continuous model also permits noninteger widths within the interval. A smooth animation can illustrate them, but they are not additional options in the integer experiment.
08.baseline-read||The original placement is valid. Its box is nine by three, with area twenty-seven. Subtract total block area twenty-three to obtain four units of empty box area.
08.overlap-predict||Next we change only A's shape. Predict whether the complete layout will remain valid.

08.overlap-change|现在只把A改成二乘三。它右侧空出一列，上方却多占了一行。D还没动，所以这次变形会碰到D。|Change only A to two by three. It frees a column on the right but occupies an extra row above. D has not moved, so the reshaped A now overlaps D.
08.overlap-area||The new region intersects D over width two and height one. The overlap area is therefore two.
08.overlap-contact||Boundary contact has zero intersection length in at least one direction and is allowed. Here both intersection lengths are positive, so the placement fails.
08.repair-side||Moving D to the right avoids A, but overlaps B. After repairing one conflict, check every other neighbor again.
08.repair-up||Place D above B. Its bottom edge cannot be below three. At the lowest permitted height, three, it touches B without overlap.
08.repair-score||Validity is restored, but box height increases to four and box area becomes thirty-six. Feasibility does not imply objective improvement.
08.repack-B||Move B left until it touches A, removing the horizontal gap between them.
08.repack-C||Move C left to touch B, preparing a lower landing position for D.
08.repack-D||Place D at four, two. It touches C's top and B's right edge, reducing box area back to twenty-seven.
08.bottle-predict||Which block still determines the outer edge of the bounding box?
08.bottle-edge||A remains at the origin, while E extends the right edge to nine. Tightening only the other blocks leaves box width unchanged at nine.
08.space-D||Move D to zero, three, freeing a two-by-two region above C.
08.space-E||Place E in that space. The right edge retreats to six, and height is four. The valid bounding area is twenty-four.
08.space-swap||This edit sequence makes room before compacting. Its intermediate area increases temporarily. Evaluate the final placement separately from the intermediate edits.
08.space-path||The animation illustrates edit endpoints. It does not claim that every frame is a collision-free physical transport path.
08.metric-fixed||For these valid layouts, block area and outline area are unchanged. Outline utilization stays twenty-three over eighty and cannot measure the compaction.
08.metric-box||Packing density rises from about eighty-five point two percent to ninety-five point eight percent, because bounding area falls from twenty-seven to twenty-four.
08.proof-area||A valid bounding box must contain total block area twenty-three. This gives a lower bound for every placement.
08.proof-integer||Integer dimensions and coordinates make the box width and height integers too. To improve on twenty-four, we now only need to exclude area twenty-three.
08.proof-prime||Twenty-three is prime. Its only positive integer factors are one and twenty-three, so such a box would have dimensions one by twenty-three or twenty-three by one.
08.proof-exclude||Neither thin box can contain the fixed two-by-two block C. Area twenty-three is impossible, so the integer-model lower bound rises to twenty-four.
08.proof-witness||We already have a valid six-by-four placement. Its area matches the lower bound at twenty-four, proving optimality for this integer model.
08.proof-continuous||With noninteger dimensions or coordinates, bounding area need not advance in integer steps. The preceding exclusion argument cannot simply be reused for the continuous model.
08.multi-shapes||Now both A and B are soft blocks. Their areas are six and twelve, and each has two integer shape choices. C remains fixed at three by one.

08.frontier-keep|四种组合，得到的宽高依次是六乘四、五乘五、七乘四、六乘五。六乘四不比七乘四和六乘五更宽或更高，所以后两种可以删掉。但五乘五更窄，不能一起删。前沿就留下六乘四和五乘五。|The four shape combinations give six by four, five by five, seven by four, and six by five. Six by four dominates the last two: it is no worse in either dimension. Five by five is narrower, so it must remain. Keep both six by four and five by five on the frontier.

08.outline-filter||In a five-by-five outline, the area-twenty-four candidate is too wide. The five-by-five candidate fits. Keeping only the smallest-area shape would incorrectly discard the feasible solution.

08.backtrace||Each frontier candidate needs backtracking information: which child shapes were selected and where their blocks are placed. Reconstruct coordinates, then validate the result using Lab two.
08.joint-search||Return to search. A neighbor may edit the sequence pair or change a soft block's shape. Compare the three configurations with the same seeds and search budget.

08.three-config||The frozen baseline is evaluated once. Shape-only search finds twenty-five, and joint shape-and-topology search also finds twenty-five. Attribute improvements only to what this controlled experiment actually demonstrates.
08.proof-limit||A can also retain its original shape in an area-twenty-four placement. We cannot attribute every improvement over the original layout to reshaping A.

08.transfer||Change the area to eight. Continuous width may range from two to four. Width three lies in that interval, but height eight thirds is not an integer, so this shape is excluded from the integer choices.
08.finish||In the independent exercises, explain which constraint limits the choice, which blocks determine the box edges, and what evidence supports your optimality claim.
